meta.source: Subspace Systems Brand Guide (2025), subspacesystems.com styles, product-family extension (Nov 2026)

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand core: Deep space navy (Pantone 296 C). Primary dark ground for logos, app icon tiles and dark pages.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Brand core: Subspace cyan (Pantone 2985 C). The Subspace mark, and the interaction color in every product. Fill or text on navy only; fails as text on ion white (1.6:1).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Brand core: Signal violet (Pantone 2725 C). The action color: primary button fills (navy text, 6.1:1), link hover on dark, card tints at 15–20%. As text only on navy or graphite.

tokens.name: ion
tokens.usage: Brand core: Ion white (Pantone 656 C). Light ground; text and logos on navy.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Brand core: Graphite (Pantone 433 C). Alternating section bands on the website, callout panels, print. Ion, cyan and violet text all pass on it.

tokens.name: drydock-orange
tokens.usage: Product signature: Drydock. Identity only: the floor face in the Drydock icon, product-page accents, splash, the active-tool marker. Navy text on it (8.0:1); never ion text on it.

tokens.name: space-950
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Deepest ground: Drydock viewport (dark), code wells.

tokens.name: space-900
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Same value as navy; page ground in dark theme.

tokens.name: space-850
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Panels and cards on navy.

tokens.name: space-800
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Raised surfaces: menus, popovers, toolbar wells.

tokens.name: space-700
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Hairline borders on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: space-600
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Strong dividers on dark; muted text on light.

tokens.name: space-500
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Control borders on dark (3:1); subtle text on light.

tokens.name: space-400
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Subtle text on dark; control borders on light (3:1).

tokens.name: space-300
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Muted text on dark.

tokens.name: space-200
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Hairline borders on light.

tokens.name: space-100
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Sunken wells on light; front faces in the viewport.

tokens.name: space-50
tokens.usage: Neutral ramp, tinted toward navy (OKLCH hue 266). Same value as ion; page ground in light theme.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and app background.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: viewport surround, code blocks, input troughs.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, sidebars.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs (light theme adds shadow-pop and a border).

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Alternating website section bands and callout panels. Use ink and ink-muted on it, not ink-subtle.

tokens.name: inverse-bg
tokens.usage: The website footer and inverted panels.

tokens.name: inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-bg.

tokens.name: inverse-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover on inverse-bg (plain cyan on ion is 1.6:1).

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus ring on inverse-bg (the footer).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions. Decorative only; not for control outlines.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs and secondary buttons. 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headlines on bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders, disabled labels on bg and surface (4.5:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, focus, selection and the active state in every Subspace product and page. Not for button fills (see action). Light theme uses the darker cyan ink so text passes 4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (selected chips, cyan tags).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: the one thing you want the visitor or user to do.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action and action-hover (6.1:1 and up).

tokens.name: action-tint
tokens.usage: Card and offer-box fills (the site uses violet at 15–20%).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, hovered tools, selection tint over geometry.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary emphasis, link hover on dark, data series 2; text-safe on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: product
tokens.usage: The current product's signature as ink: product name accents, active-tool marker. Light value is the text-safe orange ink.

tokens.name: product-fill
tokens.usage: The current product's signature as a fill (icon floor, splash band). Pair with on-product.

tokens.name: on-product
tokens.usage: Text and icons on product-fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: viewport-bg
tokens.usage: Drydock 3D viewport background.

tokens.name: viewport-grid
tokens.usage: Ground grid lines in the viewport.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Model edges in the viewport.

tokens.name: face-front
tokens.usage: Front faces of geometry (before shading). Dark theme uses slate faces so ion edges read on faces and on the empty viewport.

tokens.name: face-back
tokens.usage: Back faces of geometry: a rose that matches nothing else in the UI, so reversed faces are obvious before export or 3D printing.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: Red axis (X / width). 3:1 on viewport-bg.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Green axis (Y / depth). 3:1 on viewport-bg.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Blue axis (Z / height). 3:1 on viewport-bg.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Website hero headline only. Orbitron Bold.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers on the website; splash and About headline in the app.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles. The smallest size Orbitron is used at.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Selected list items, app button labels, panel headers.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Website button labels. Roboto Medium, never Orbitron.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase only. Eyebrows and panel section labels.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The Measurements box and any value the user types.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Square side of the Measurements box.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Dense desktop controls: tool buttons, inputs, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus, windows; round side of the Measurements box.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, large media frames.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon tiles for every Subspace product.
